title: Files Recovery — Photo & Video
summary: Instantly restore deleted photos, videos, and files
description:
"🚨 Erased your favorite pictures or essential work documents by mistake?
Take a deep breath! Files Recovery — Photo & Video is your ultimate rescue tool to easily retrieve deleted data directly from your smartphone.

🎯 What We Can Rescue For You
📸 Media Recovery: Swiftly undelete lost pictures and video clips. Fully compatible with formats like MP4, MOV, JPEG, PNG, and more.
📄 Document Retrieval: Missing an important report? Get back your PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files in seconds.
☎️ Phone Data: Restore your wiped address book, contacts, and call history.
⚙️ Universal Compatibility: Deeply scans your mobile storage to recognize and recover a vast variety of file types.

🌟 Smart, Secure & User-Friendly
👀 Pre-Recovery Preview: Check and view your scanned files to ensure they are exactly what you need before hitting restore.
📱 100% Offline Processing: We respect your privacy. The entire recovery engine runs locally on your device without any internet uploads.
🔓 No Root Required: Enjoy powerful deep scanning capabilities without the need to root or modify your phone's system.

🛡️ Ironclad Privacy Protection
Your personal data belongs to you alone. Our app strictly performs local scans and NEVER collects, stores, or transmits your private files to any external servers. The storage access permission is used exclusively to locate and retrieve your lost items.

🚀 4 Simple Steps to Recover:
1️⃣ Select the data category you wish to find (Images, Videos, Docs, etc.).
2️⃣ Tap to initiate the smart deep scan.
3️⃣ Scroll through the detailed scan results.
4️⃣ Choose the items you want and restore them instantly!

⏳ Don't Let Your Data Disappear Forever!
The quicker you scan, the better your chances of a successful recovery. Download Files Recovery — Photo & Video today and bring your valuable memories and files back to life!"
